items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Well, you had Ace Harris, didn't you

ctx.x: Yeah, Duke -- name was Duke. I've forgotten Duke's last name, very good piano player, though. I think Avery had left the band then.
Well, you had Ace Harris, didn't you, Erskine Hawkins and Ace Harris later? And -- oh, I don't know. Yeah, I guess Avery left around '40 something, yeah.
Yeah, because this boy didn't stayed with Erskine too long, Duke didn't.
